resources.string: Step 1 is not done: the game code is not on this device. It is made from your own discs.\nOn your PC, run setup\\setup.cmd -Game aw (on Linux: bash setup/setup.sh --game aw) with this device connected over USB.

The game code on this device does not match this version of the app: %1$s.\n\nBuild it again: on your PC, update the project folder (git pull) and run setup\\setup.cmd -Game aw -GameOnly with this device connected over USB. Your game files and saves are kept.
Game disc found:\n%1$s\nInstall & Play copies it, then asks for the install disc.

This game has two discs. Point this at the image (.iso) of your own game disc, on this device or its memory card, and tap Install; then at the image of the install disc when it asks. Both are copied into the app, about 12 GB together.
About 7 GB from the game disc and 4 GB from the install disc, on the device\'s own storage; a minute or two each. The images are not needed afterwards.
UNOFFICIAL. NOT AFFILIATED WITH ACTIVISION, SLEDGEHAMMER GAMES OR MICROSOFT.

1. BUILD THE GAME CODE (%1$s): on this device, with no PC: choose \"Build the game code\" and your game disc\'s image (.iso); it took about 13 minutes on a Snapdragon 865. Or on a PC: run %3$s with this device connected over USB.\n2. INSTALL & PLAY (%2$s): copies the game out of your two disc images (.iso), the game disc and then the install disc; about 12 GB on this device. The images may lie on an SD card.

The game code is made from your own copy of the game, here on this device. It needs the game disc\'s two executables, the toolchain package (the compiler, installed once, a download of about 45 MB) and about 1 GB of free space while it works. The build took about 13 minutes on a Retroid Pocket Flip 2 (Snapdragon 865), the one device it was measured on, and takes longer on a slower or hot one; it carries on while you use other apps, and from where it was if it is interrupted.
